title: The Late Bakery
author: F. M. Montrose
blurb: Jude Voss, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
